title: A persistent-homology-Gaussian prior for solving infinite-dimensional Bayesian inverse scattering problems
summary: Bayesian inference methods have been developed to address inverse problems in function spaces where the unknown parameters are of infinite dimension. However, conventional Gaussian priors remain inadequate for reconstructing discontinuous or sharply varying target functions encountered in practical applications like obstacle reconstruction. Although hybrid priors have emerged as a promising solution, significant challenges remain in developing theoretically rigorous and computationally tractable frameworks in engineering applications.
